description: Environment variables stella-ai-agent-sdk reads for every agent. Generated from stella_agent_sdk.platform_env; do not edit by hand.

env.name: INTERRUPT_MODE
env.description: Transcript interrupt behaviour: 'none' (turn-based gating) or 'smart' (barge-in with re-prompting).

env.name: TRANSCRIPT_DEBOUNCE_MS
env.description: Window (ms) for joining rapid successive final transcripts into one turn. 0 disables it.

env.name: BARGE_IN_ENABLED
env.description: Operator override for barge-in: 'false' forces it off, 'true' on. Unset follows the agent's supports_barge_in.

env.name: BARGE_IN_EVAL_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: How long (ms) the barge-in evaluator may take to decide commit or resume before the agent resumes.

env.name: BARGE_IN_DUCK_GAIN
env.description: Volume (0-1) the agent's voice drops to while the user may be interrupting.

env.name: BARGE_IN_DUCK_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: How long (ms) the voice stays ducked without the user's speech becoming an interruption.

env.name: BARGE_IN_SUSPEND_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: How long (ms) playback stays suspended waiting for the interrupting transcript before it resumes.

env.name: BARGE_IN_STORM_COUNT
env.description: Barge-ins within BARGE_IN_STORM_WINDOW_MS that switch barge-in off for a cool-down (echo protection).

env.name: BARGE_IN_STORM_WINDOW_MS
env.description: Window (ms) in which BARGE_IN_STORM_COUNT barge-ins count as a storm.

env.name: BARGE_IN_STORM_COOLDOWN_MS
env.description: How long (ms) barge-in stays off after a storm.

env.name: STELLA_LANGUAGE
env.description: Pin the conversation to one language (ISO 639-1, e.g. 'de'): STT, the reply and the voice follow it. Empty or 'auto' detects per turn.

env.name: TTS_ENABLED
env.description: Speak replies. 'false' runs the agent text-only.

env.name: TTS_LANGUAGE
env.description: Seed language for TTS (ISO 639-1). Empty follows the language resolved per turn.

env.name: TTS_VOICE
env.description: Seed TTS voice, for providers that select voices (e.g. Kokoro). Empty is the provider default.

env.name: TTS_SPEED
env.description: Baseline speaking rate (0.5-2.0). Rate is implemented by resampling, so it shifts pitch too.

env.name: TTS_PROGRESS_TICK_MS
env.description: How often (ms) a teleprompter progress envelope is sent during playback.

env.name: TTS_PLAYOUT_BUFFER_MS
env.description: Audio (ms) the room may queue ahead of playout.

env.name: STELLA_TTS_PLAYBACK
env.description: 'auto' starts streaming and switches once to 'sentence' if synthesis cannot keep up; 'stream' or 'sentence' pins it. 'auto' follows the platform default.

env.name: STELLA_TTS_PREROLL_MS
env.description: Fix the audio head start (ms) before each sentence plays. Unset (recommended) lets the SDK measure and adapt it; 0 also disables the underrun guard.

env.name: STELLA_TTS_RATE_VARIATION
env.description: Vary the speaking rate slightly by turn character. 'false' speaks every utterance at one rate.

env.name: SESSION_END_MODE
env.description: What the agent does when the session time runs out: 'farewell' says the plan's farewell, 'wrap_up' lets the agent write a short closing, 'silent' just ends. An agent may choose it another way.

env.name: STELLA_TELEPROMPTER_ENABLED
env.description: Light the reply up word by word as it is spoken. 'false' turns it off.

env.name: STELLA_EMOTION_TAGS_ENABLED
env.description: Turn [emotion] tags in replies into face cues. 'false' turns it off.
